uses.text: Osanetant (developmental code name SR-142,801) is a neurokinin 3 receptor antagonist which was developed by Sanofi-Synthélabo and was being researched for the treatment of schizophrenia but was discontinued. Osanetant is being investigated by Acer Therapeutics as a treatment for severe vasomotor symptoms such as a hot flashes and flushes among women experiencing menopause.

fact.en: The neurokinin receptors it acts on were named from the Greek for new and for movement, because the first of these peptides was found to make gut muscle contract.
fact.zh: 它作用的神經激素（neurokinin）受體，名稱來自希臘文的「新」與「運動」，因為這類胜肽中第一個被發現的會使腸道肌肉收縮。
fact.zhHans: 它作用的神经激素（neurokinin）受体，名称来自希腊文的「新」与「运动」，因为这类胜肽中第一个被发现的会使肠道肌肉收缩。
